name: Social Prediction Error Circuit
short_description: Compares expected social responses against actual responses in context to detect norm violations and generate social learning signals.

components.name: SOCIAL_EXPECTATION_MODEL
components.description: Maintains predictive models of social partner behavior based on context and history

components.name: RESPONSE_COMPARATOR
components.description: Detects mismatch between social prediction and actual social response

components.name: CONTEXT_INTEGRATOR
components.description: Integrates contextual information to assess appropriateness of response

components.name: NORM_VIOLATION_DETECTOR
components.description: Synthesizes response mismatch and context to detect social norm violations

key_references: Kilner, J. M., Friston, K. J., & Frith, C. D. (2007). Predictive coding: An account of the mirror neuron system. Cognitive Processing, 8(3), 159–166.
Kube, A., Rozenkrantz, L., & Schaafsma, S. M. (2020). Advances in social neuroscience research: Bridging neurobiology and social psychology. Current Opinion in Psychology, 31, 52–58.
design_implications: Social spaces should clearly communicate norms and expectations; use visible cues (signage, layout, examples) to establish behavioral expectations
Spaces for cross-cultural interaction should accommodate diverse social prediction models; avoid implicit norm assumptions that exclude unfamiliar groups
